title: Read a Config
story: Config files are just KEY=VALUE lines. Turn one into a dictionary.
goal: Write parse_kv(text): return a dict of key to value (both text). Ignore blank lines and lines starting with #.
hints: splitlines() gives you the lines. Skip empty ones and the ones that start with #.
Use line.split("=", 1) so only the first = splits.
socratic: Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what is the key idea in “Read a Config”?
